user.title: Connect to your eProWallbox
user.description: Enter the IP address, the port and the Modbus framing of your wallbox. The eProWallbox Move usually needs "Modbus RTU over TCP".

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the address, the port, the framing (RTU over TCP / Modbus TCP) and the wallbox Modbus settings.
